item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to Atlantic views
item.description: Standing at the base of the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, visitors can admire its striking red brick tower rising high above the inlet. Built in 1860, the lighthouse has guided countless ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Defeats Coco Gauff to Reach Wimbledon Final
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.
